name: heritage-housing-projects
description: Heritage Housing Projects (Pvt) Ltd — corporate website and secure client portal.

comments.zero-dependencies: This project intentionally has no runtime dependencies. It uses only Node's standard library: node:http, node:sqlite, node:crypto, node:fs. There is no install step and no lockfile to audit.
comments.node-version: node:sqlite requires Node 22.5 or newer. Developed and tested on Node 24.
comments.npm: npm is not required. 'node server/index.js' is the whole build and run story.
